spoken_first_2s: गोल्ड की जो ज्वेलरी है उसमें उसे खरीदते

notes.hook: podcast clip: 'gold jewellery khareedte waqt pehli cheez...'
notes.what_goes_wrong: The useful insight (a jeweller charges you three things: gold price, wastage, making) arrives only at 24-34s behind a rambling setup.
notes.reusable_pattern: Lead with the money insight ('your jeweller charges you 3 things'); a podcast clip needs its punchline first.
